SELECT object, event_record_id, time AS timestamp, source_stream, pid, ppid, parent_process_name, parent_command_line, command_line
FROM audit_logs
WHERE (object LIKE '%Discord%' OR command_line LIKE '%Discord%' OR parent_command_line LIKE '%Discord%' OR parent_process_name LIKE '%Discord%')
  AND (access LIKE '%reg%' OR access LIKE '%file%' OR source_object_type LIKE '%Registry%' OR source_object_type LIKE '%File%')
ORDER BY time ASC, event_record_id ASC
LIMIT 1;
